title: Griffith Observatory Electric Mountain Bike Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: What sets this experience apart is the rare combination of adventure and culture in a single tour. Guests ride top-tier electric mountain bikes on quiet fire roads with sweeping views, Hollywood Sign photo stops, and an easy, beginner-friendly flow. Then, unlike most bike tours, this one includes a full visit to Griffith Observatory—exploring exhibits, planetarium areas, rooftop lookouts, and enjoying time for bathrooms or a snack at the café. It’s two iconic LA experiences in one seamless, curated adventure.
